name: UCI Online Shoppers Purchasing Intention Dataset
description: The UCI Online Shoppers Purchasing Intention Dataset consists of 12,330 online user shopping sessions over 1-year period, characterized by 17 administrative, informational, and website navigational metrics designed to predict purchasing intent.

publisher.name: Bogazici University & UCI Machine Learning Repository

source_references.title: Real-Time Prediction of Online Shoppers' Purchasing Intention Using Multilayer Perceptron and LSTM Recurrent Neural Networks
source_references.notes: Published in Neural Computing and Applications (2019), DOI: 10.1007/s00521-018-3523-0.

verification.notes: Verified against UCI Machine Learning Repository DataCite record (DOI: 10.24432/C5F88Q) and Neural Computing and Applications 2019 publication (DOI: 10.1007/s00521-018-3523-0). Exactly 12,330 sessions, 17 features (10 numerical, 7 categorical), and binary Revenue label (1,908 returning purchase sessions, 10,422 negative sessions).
